title: Survey findings
description: What the maintainer's survey found worth filing. A script files each entry as an issue and adds each epic link; nothing else the survey wants reaches GitHub.

body.description: What should be true when it is done, and why. `Covers:`, `Part of #<epic>` and `Depends on #<n>` lines are read as written.

epic.description: true files it as an epic (sdlc:epic): bigger than one issue, and next. Otherwise the watchdog starts it like any other issue.

issues.description: Two good issues beat ten plausible ones; an empty list is a fine answer.

depends_on.description: The open epic it cannot be built before.

epic_links.description: Epics whose product genuinely cannot be built before another's. A script adds `Depends on #<depends_on>` to each `epic`; both must be open issues labelled sdlc:epic.
